text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the line in 1st place, 
Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad she won...! She was amazing, 
truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the courage!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all too...! Thank you, 
Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cheers roared, enveloping 
Matikanetannhauser. Standing on the turf, 
she looked up at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's smiles... so, so, so many of 
them...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (This is something I——)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Today's star is Matikanetannhauser! She 
delivers the long-awaited victory right to 
the stands!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So pretty. ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, I won. Maybe I can brag about this 
just a little?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
For now, we just have to eat something 
delicious today, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Machitaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaah!?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Congraats!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What an energetic Umamusume! Th-Thank 
youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm the slowest in the club, I 
can never win, and I have no talent. 
But... but still—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! Because Machitan gave it her 
all too!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Thanks! —See ya later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those parting words, the small 
Umamusume ran off full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It seems right now, I was able to become 
that child's "protagonist."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Nhehe. Hehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser watched over the little 
Umamusume until she was out of sight.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nn... Alright, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
My racing career has only just begun, so I 
can't be satisfied with just this, right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep doing our best together, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside a newfound resolve, the 
"Arima Kinen" came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I think I might've left my phone 
in the waiting room!"
